moTaTrang: How we protect personal data, free reservations at {diaDiem}, terms of use, and details about {congTy}.
gioiThieu: Applies to the VIVE product experience website and the reservation counter at {diaDiem}.

mucDich.noiDung: Your name, phone number, and email are used to reserve products and send your pickup code; skin quiz answers and swipes are used to recommend suitable products. Deal emails are sent only with your opt-in consent via a separate unticked checkbox, and you can unsubscribe with one tap at the bottom of every email.

thoiGianLuu.noiDung: Reservation records are deleted or anonymized after 12 months; swipe history is anonymized after 12 months; deal emails are kept until you unsubscribe.

benXuLy.noiDung: Supabase and Google Cloud; data may be stored on servers outside Vietnam (Japan).

quyen.noiDung: You have the right to view, edit, delete your data, or withdraw consent via booth staff or our contact email

cookie.noiDung: Used only to remember your language, cart, and liked items; not used for advertising.

treEm.noiDung: Customers under 16 need consent from a parent or guardian before reserving products.

thanhToan.noiDung: Reserving on the web is completely free and needs no payment upfront. You pay and pick up your products at the KiotViet POS counter at {diaDiem}.

gia.noiDung: Totals and gifts on the web are estimates based on the promotions running when the code is created. Staff will confirm them again at checkout.

han.noiDung: Your reservation code is valid until {gio} on your pickup date. After that, the order expires automatically so the stock goes back to customers at the counter.

doiTra.noiDung: Please check that the product and its seal are intact when you receive it. All return requests are handled in person at the {cuaHang} counter or via {email}.

nhanPhu.noiDung: Products sold at the counter carry Vietnamese supplementary labels as required by regulations.

khuyenMai.noiDung: Promotions apply according to the schedule and conditions published at the counter and on the website; staff confirm at checkout.

gia.noiDung: Website prices may change; the counter price at checkout is final.

hinhAnh.noiDung: Images on the website are for illustration only.

gioiHanDon.noiDung: Each phone number may hold up to 3 open reservations at a time.

lamDung.noiDung: VIVE reserves the right to cancel reservation codes showing signs of abuse.

luatApDung.noiDung: These terms are governed by the laws of Vietnam.
